source.title: Storm Sewer Tabulation (07698SWS.stm, PDF pp. 46-47) with the 100-yr coefficients of the Hydraflow Rainfall Report on PDF p. 35 of the same document

assumptions: The Storm Sewers run used SedgwickCoKS.IDF: its printed equation 62.28 / (Tc + 10.10)^0.66 is the report's 100-yr B, D, E rounded, and both runs are project 07698 in the same document.
notes: Line flow only; pipe capacity and HGL remain in the partial storm-one-line-outfall-100yr case.
